text: In consideration of the Works the Owner shall pay the Contractor the lump-sum Contract Price of EUR 532,480,000 (five hundred and thirty-two million four hundred and eighty thousand euros), comprising an offshore portion of EUR 327,000,000 and an onshore portion of EUR 205,480,000, exclusive of Value Added Tax, payable in accordance with Clause 15 and Appendix C. The Contract Price is fixed and not subject to escalation or exchange-rate adjustment, except as adjusted under Clause 14.
title: Contract Price
